title: Special meeting to authorize closed session
subtitle: Urgent security of property item added; two land matters considered in-camera; brief meeting adjourned after two minutes.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on October 16, 2023, chaired by the Mayor. It opened with a land acknowledgement. No pecuniary interests were disclosed and there was no mayoral business.

Council agreed to waive the notice requirement so an urgent item could be added to the closed-session agenda. The item concerns by-law violations on City land and falls under the security of property provision of the Municipal Act, 2001 {{vote:m1}}. Waiving notice required two-thirds of members present.

Council then authorized an in-camera meeting immediately after the open session. It would consider two land acquisition or disposition matters and the added security of property matter {{vote:m2}}. The open meeting adjourned at 5:02 p.m. and no decisions on the closed-session matters were reported. Residents should expect any outcomes on these topics to be made public later through the usual process.

decisions.item: Waive notice for urgent closed-session item
decisions.detail: Council waived the notice-of-motion requirement to add an urgent security of property matter about by-law violations on City land to the closed-session agenda.
Council authorized a closed session after the special meeting to consider two land acquisition or disposition matters and the added security of property matter.

debate: There was no substantive debate in the open session; the transcript shows only procedural steps.
Before the vote to waive notice, a councillor asked how many members were needed, and was told the two-thirds threshold applied.
The urgent item was described only as by-law violations on City land under security of property, with no further detail given publicly.
